name: end-thanks
description: 结尾致谢：居中「谢谢观看」+ 联系药丸（轻 outro 变体）
css: #tpl-end-thanks { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); gap: 3vh; text-align: center; } .et-big { font-size: 9vh; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .et-pill { background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); color: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); padding: 1vh 3vh; border-radius: 3vh; font-size: 2.2vh; font-weight: 700; }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .et-big", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.86 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "back.out(1.4)" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .et-pill", { y: 26, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.5);
